description: Denoises each training sweep with cross-validated Savitzky–Golay filtering, then interpolates across stimulus amplitude using several passive-regime models: local voltage and conductance interpolation, shape-preserving interpolation, monotonic interpolation, and constrained/unconstrained low-order polynomials. Leave-one-amplitude-out validation is performed only on the two interior training amplitudes, preserving whole sweeps; the best smoothing/hyperparameter setting per model family is retained and the strongest families are validation-weighted. This avoids using test labels while exploiting both temporal smoothness and the expected near-linear, mildly nonlinear current–voltage relationship.
